newsitem.title: USA: APPLE SAYS NOTHING ON MAC CLONES FUTURE-NYT.
newsitem.headline: APPLE SAYS NOTHING ON MAC CLONES FUTURE-NYT.

text.p: It is still unclear whether Apple Computer Inc will continue to license its Macintosh operating system to makers of lower-priced Mac clones, the New York Times reported.
Apple executives were nearly silent on the issue, which is considered of strategic importance to the company, at last week's MacWorld Expo trade show, the paper said.
The absence of any straight answers on the issue is fuelling speculation that Apple seems to think the clones do Apple more harm than good.
Clones now account for one out of every five Macintosh computers sold, the paper said.
